map_info.name: Shannon Lab
map_info.description: The Shannon bound test chamber. A 'bright minimal' Half-Life-style lab room procedurally built around the shannon_workbench. Lambda-edge red accent strip names the QFEP phase. White tile floor, observation glass at the entrance, signage reading 'TEST CHAMBER λ-S · Shannon Bound Probe'. The room IS the staging — the workbench is the instrument, the chamber tells you what kind of measurement you're about to take. Built 2026-05-20 as a sample wrapper for the 11 existing workbenches; the lab_room artifact generalizes to all of them by changing accent color, signage, and mounted_artifact_scene.

learning_objectives: Walk into a test chamber that frames the instrument it houses
Read the accent color, signage, and wall annotations as scaffolding for the experiment
Interact with the Shannon binary-entropy workbench at the central plinth
